svg.title: The spread of output across months follows the same shape in both years
svg.desc: Dot chart: The spread of output across months follows the same shape in both years: in 2019: Jan: 3.04%, Feb: 5.50%, Mar: 8.23%, Apr: 10.54%, May: 11.12%, Jun: 13.58%, Jul: 12.90%, Aug: 12.29%, Sep: 9.60%, Oct: 6.78%, Nov: 3.25%, Dec: 3.18%; in 2025: Jan: 3.03%, Feb: 4.77%, Mar: 8.21%, Apr: 10.41%, May: 12.04%, Jun: 13.30%, Jul: 12.89%, Aug: 12.47%, Sep: 9.41%, Oct: 6.39%, Nov: 4.15%, Dec: 2.95%.
